summary: ADR-0093 applies only to the single original .103 authentication-only operation. Programme owns policy/change control and source review; EHotwagner retains separate App/credential custody; SystemAdmin owns separate supervised ACK-service design/later custody outside the key-free facts store and original job/runner/VM. Six means six logical ordinals; 65,536 total bytes counts the complete signed/schema population, every simultaneous physical copy, host/peer control and old/temp/candidate uncertainty evidence including memory retained as authority or uncertainty. Unproved fit/overflow refuses source/runtime admission without eviction or omission. Retention ends 90 days after the original total cutoff without read renewal; RetentionExpired/Unknown preserves original holds. Private v1/v2 receipt and v3 planning review superseded the historical unavailable-packet status; v3 64,000-byte slot arithmetic was planning only. Protected .github PR4565 plus correction PR4567 at a8384157c5622c7e0629b6d9129a6fbe8a96428a deliver the accepted inert serialized construction subset: 57,562 proposed encoded bytes and 7,974 headroom under its closed model; 68 pure authentication tests and hosted qualifications passed. Exact child binding/original pins remain, publisher provenance differs from executing authentication, and the external descriptor commits exact binding and full-ready digests. Wrapped structural ready/start bounds are 1,291/1,273 bytes within 2,048. Legacy BE-u32 child ACK b,h,k,n,v is distinct from the 510-byte framed external ACK; 546-byte diagnostic response is separate from the 512-byte callback retain response and cannot become a gate. Trusted authenticated readback must still join exact issuer/descriptor/frame/checkpoint/ordinal/purpose/challenge/generation/original clock to TakeAck/ConfirmAckSent one-use/full-write/cutoff checks. Placeholder signatures are not authenticated positive evidence. The model counts host/peer overlap and independent same-token 204 observations; uncertain core freezes further core/phase/gate mutation, with separately reserved append-once loss/expiry slots and no uncertain-observation retry. First failure/holds survive. PR4567 corrects the earlier absent late-cause representation: signed append-once loss/expiry observations carry optional closed lateCause phase/code after core freeze without changing earlier core firstCause, even when absent. Maximum observation grows427 to497 bytes within512; four reserved copies add280. The first possible write consumes its immutable slot, with no retry after loss/restart/ambiguity. Actual managed/native fit remains unproved: public pinned PhaseResultSnapshot retains frame/payload arrays and accessor copies; callback source retains a pending base64 frame. Caller/accessor/callback retention is not bounded by the API. Source owner owes the simultaneous-copy/lifetime census and exact slot mapping across task/queue/sink/readback/serialization/restart. Seven extra maximum-ready copies add 9,037 bytes, exceeding headroom; this is a possible-copy counterexample, not an observed retained population. Working-array exclusions require bounded lifetime, lack of authority and a separate finite memory bound. Metadata/allocated blocks/runtime/native enforcement, actual signer custody/enrollment, barrier/fresh exact readback, original-clock finite uncertainty/continuity and independent loss proof remain open. Interface freeze and installed/native admission stay held; production provider/workflow unchanged. Preserve original same-token independent HTTP 204, whole-job/runner/VM loss Unknown/unqualified/unretried and original 270/285/300-second cutoffs. All six native selections/admission/effect flags remain false; original .103 tag attempted-unknown/unreplayed and .104 held. No source-model result authorizes native/credential/release effects.
title: Original .103 policy accepts an inert serialized construction subset; actual population and effects stay held
